source: the seat launcher run-pi-seat.mjs streams Pi in --mode json to stdout, one JSON event per line; captured here from a reviewer-backup run started in an Orca plain terminal
how_read: the last type=message_end event with message.role=assistant carries provider, model and usage (input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite, reasoning, totalTokens, cost.total in dollars)
verdict_text: VERDICT: FAIL — the change implements subtraction instead of addition, contradicting the commit message and the function's intended behavior.
gaps: no peak-context figure (only per-message totals, which for a multi-turn run the controller must track itself) and no duration field on events (the controller must time the process)
